name: Shortcut Settings
author: Vestra Player
punchline: View and rebind keyboard shortcuts and mouse actions
description:
Lists the commands of the player and of every plugin in the Keys and Mouse category of the options window: search by command or key, rebind, unbind, restore defaults, check conflicts and export the list. Assigns commands to mouse clicks and the wheel on the video, and can ignore every default shortcut at once.
→ Options (F5) ▸ Keys and Mouse
